20 free servers are waiting for you

Welcome to TAHA VPN 5G! You already have 20 free servers — the fastest servers that really have a ping and are ready to connect right now. You do not need to pick a server: tap the connect switch and the app finds the fastest server, and if it drops mid-way, it moves to the next one by itself. The free session is 30 minutes; half an hour of free internet to start. And one note: while you are reading this, the servers are updating in the background with the national network — so do not rush, read it to the end!

Do you have a gift code? Enter it in the “Premium” section: 24 hours of gift servers open up — 100 fast servers instead of 20. If you are looking for all countries, the Pro version opens all countries and all servers; with no 30-minute timer and no stopping. Purchase codes work here too — packages of 20 to 200 GB or subscriptions of 1 to 12 months.

By using TAHA VPN 5G I accept the following:
• The free session is 30 minutes.
• Gift codes and subscriptions are linked to my user account after registration.
• Using the service for illegal activity is forbidden.
• Servers and prices may change.

In auto mode, the app picks the fastest free server that has a ping; if a server fails to tunnel or the connection drops, it moves to the next server on its own. Tap the “Auto” row to go back to this mode.

Tap the big switch in the middle of the screen. The app first checks the internet, then picks the fastest free server, builds the tunnel, and only shows “Connected” once traffic really goes through the VPN. If a server does not work, it moves to the next one automatically.
In auto mode, the app picks the fastest free server that has a ping. A server that recently failed to tunnel is set aside for 6 hours and is not tried again.

Tap the “Free servers” row, pick the country, then the server. Your choice is saved and next time you connect to the same server, unless you tap “Auto” again. If a manual server is broken, the app does not silently pick another one; it shows the exact error and you can go back to auto.
The 20 fastest servers with a ping are free; the rest are premium. A server with no ping is never shown and never tried first.
Locked countries open with a subscription. You get the subscription from the Telegram bot; your subscription status is shown on the “Me” screen and on the “Premium” screen.
6. If a server does not work
The app tries the next server until a real tunnel is confirmed; there is no fixed retry cap. If no server tunnels, you see the exact error and stay “Not connected”; refresh the list and try again.
Every connection stops automatically after 30 minutes; this is the free version limit. To continue, tap the connect switch again.

After connecting, the app takes the exit IP from inside the tunnel and compares it with the IP before the connection. If the IP has not changed or no response comes back, the tunnel is not working and “Connected” is not shown. The same check repeats every 60 seconds.
DNS is done from inside the tunnel so there is no DNS leak. The packet size (MTU) is also set automatically: 1500 on Wi-Fi and 1400 on mobile data.
If you tap any other server, the current connection is fully disconnected and the tunnel is built and checked again from scratch with the new server. There is always only one active tunnel.

Copy a config link (vmess, vless, trojan or ss) and open it in the app, or download a .txt or .json file from the channel and tap it to open it in the app. A broken or incomplete config (for example without SNI or without a REALITY key) will not import.
Pull the screen down to refresh the list; the app also refreshes it automatically every 5 minutes. Servers come from online services; without internet, the last saved list is shown.

Registration and sign-in are only with email and password; no code is sent. You enter your email and password and sign in to your account. Do not forget your password; if you do, the “Forgot password” link sends a recovery link to your email.

If you signed out of your account, tap “Forgot password” on the sign-in screen; the recovery link is sent to the same email. Open the link, set a new password and sign in to your account. No code is sent; if the link did not arrive, check the spam folder first.

If you got a discount or gift code from the bot, enter it on the “Premium” screen. Gift codes and purchase codes both activate at once inside the app; after the server confirms, no step in the bot is needed. A gift code gives a few hours and a purchase code gives a few days (depending on the plan). A discount code is applied in the bot.
When a new version is released, the app tells you itself; it downloads with one tap and the system installer opens. From version 1.1.4 on, updates install over the previous version.
The app never records your password, verification code or the full config address anywhere. Connections are only made over HTTPS, the final build cannot be debugged, and app-data backup is off.
While you are connected, the service stays active in the background so the connection does not drop. Turning the screen off does not disconnect. The connection stops automatically after 30 minutes.

“No internet available”: check the phone’s internet. “No server tunneled”: refresh the list and try again. “VPN permission was not granted”: confirm the VPN permission in the system window when connecting. “Recovery link did not arrive”: look in the spam folder and request again.
If you have a problem that is not answered here, reach us through these three ways:
How do I sign in to my account?

Sign-in is only with email and password; no verification code is sent. If you forgot your password, tap “Forgot password” on the sign-in screen and a recovery link will be sent to your email. Link did not arrive? Check the spam folder first.
Why does the connection stop after 30 minutes?
This is the free version limit; every connection lasts 30 minutes. To continue, tap the connect switch again.
Only the 20 fastest servers are free; the other countries are premium and open with a subscription. You get the subscription from the Telegram bot.
Why is the server list empty?
The list is fetched from the internet; if you are offline, the last saved list is shown. Pull the screen down to refresh and make sure the internet is connected.
Ping is the round-trip time to the server (in milliseconds); the lower it is, the faster the server. The app always picks the fastest free server.
Can I add my own config?
Yes; open a config link (vmess, vless, trojan or ss) in the app, or import a .txt or .json file. The config must be complete and valid, otherwise it will not import.
Is it different on Wi-Fi and mobile data?
No; the app works on both, and the packet size is adjusted automatically to the network type. If the network changes, the app checks the tunnel again.
The VPN is connected but nothing opens; what do I do?

The app checks the tunnel every 60 seconds; if the tunnel really does not work, it disconnects by itself and tries the next server. If the problem continues, disconnect, refresh the list and connect to another server.
Where do I see my active plan and its expiry date?

On the “Premium” screen, in the subscription status section: you see the plan name, the days left (for a gift code: the hours left) and the volume used, right there. The “Me” screen also has a summary of your subscription.
How much volume does my plan have and how much have I used?

The volume cap of each plan is set by the admin; on the “Premium” screen you see the used and remaining volume with a progress bar. Usage is measured from the real tunnel bytes on this very phone and adds up for the same subscription. The server does not report each user’s usage, so the number you see is the phone’s own measurement. If your plan has no volume cap, “Unlimited” is shown. When the volume or the time of the plan runs out — whichever comes first — the subscription ends.
